0x0008C2.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000933.en: 「Kh! @　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009BB.en: 「Dammit! @　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B1C.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000C20.en: 「No way I screw up here...!@　This isn't any fun...」

0x000C74.en: 「Messed up...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000CE8.en: 「Kh! Nothing for it but to fall back!!」

0x000D5E.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DC5.en: 「This is the end for me... the rest is on you.」

0x000E71.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000EBE.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. The rest is up to you.」

0x000EFC.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000F43.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FEE.en: 「Gah... So I end up a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010A5.en: 「Owowow... I give. Miscalculation on my part.」

0x00112A.en: 「Nngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001197.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011DE.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001213.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!?」

0x0012D0.en: 「Heh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0012FF.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x00134D.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0013C6.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm pulling out of this one...!」

0x001408.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001437.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001475.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0014A4.en: 「I can't do any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x00152F.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0015AC.en: 「Tch...! I couldn't hold out after all...!」

0x001923.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandoning ship is our top priority...!!」

0x001A15.en: 「Now then, I'll report on the current findings that@ Ensign Lamia and I have compiled regarding the Ruina's@ dimensional rift.」

0x001ABA.en: 「We believe the rift cuts out the space around Earth and drops it whole into another dimension, severing Earth from its original one.」

0x001B7D.en: 「To put it simply...@ picture Earth drawn on a sheet of paper, then cut@ around it leaving one part attached, and fold it under.」

0x001C25.en: 「That way, Earth can no longer see the paper's surface - the surface itself vanishes from space, as if Earth had disappeared.」

0x001CE2.en: 「But we can't see that cut-out hole, can we?」

0x001D22.en: 「I believe the Ruina are distorting space somehow to@ seal the hole. Even after Earth vanished, we can still@ see the space beyond it.」

0x001DE5.en: 「But if Earth's in another dimension...@ how is the moon still orbiting like nothing happened?」

0x001E5C.en: 「R-right. If Earth vanished, shouldn't the moon@ go flying off somewhere?」

0x001ED3.en: 「Perhaps gravity acts across dimensions,@ as in braneworld theory...」

0x001F32.en: 「That's our guess as well.@ And it leads us to another inference.」

0x001F91.en: 「As Ariel just explained, part of the paper stays@ connected. In other words, Earth wasn't completely@ severed into the other dimension.」

0x00204B.en: 「As the Ruina's appearance in space shows, the rift@ must have an entrance and exit... a tiny hole linking@ our dimension to the other.」

0x002111.en: 「And... we infer it lies somewhere in the space@ where Earth used to be.」

0x0021BF.en: 「If the Ruina are moving in and out of it, yes.」

0x002236.en: 「There's one likely point.@ The skies above the Antarctic, the Ruina's base.」

0x0022A7.en: 「Well, coming out right there@ would be the quickest way for them.」

0x002300.en: 「But how the Ruina widen the hole and pass through@ the rift... we won't know until we see it@ for ourselves.」

0x0023A5.en: 「Even so, they must take the utmost care moving@ between the layers. I doubt they'd let us@ see it so easily.」

0x002441.en: 「Might be faster to just wring the answer@ out of the Melior Esse...」

0x0024D4.en: 「No, she's got a point. Hit the Ruina at Heaven's Gate and they'll react somehow - flee, call for backup, something.」

0x00258E.en: 「Watching for that is our best bet@ right now, isn't it?」

0x0025ED.en: 「Well, it is our style, I'll give you that.」

0x002621.en: 「But nonstop fighting has burned through our ammo. We were due to resupply after the Antarctic op, but that's still up in the air.」

0x0026ED.en: 「Depending on the situation on the moon,@ our next moves may be hamstrung.」

0x002756.en: 「Major Kai, Captain Viletta, to the bridge, urgent.@ We've made contact with a Federation transport convoy.」

0x0027EF.en: 「Yes.@ Staff from <Mao Industries> are with them, apparently.」

0x002892.en: 「The convoy escaped the moon via Mao Industries@ and was headed for the colony cluster@ in the L4 region, they say.」

0x002925.en: (Fleeing the moon... Are things that bad up there?)

0x00299F.en: 「Radha Byraban and@ Dr. Marion Radom's team, apparently.」

0x002A07.en: 「Them aside... is the convoy okay with@ making contact with us?」

0x002A6C.en: 「It seems so.@ Radha says there's no problem either, so@ I'm thinking we link up with them, but...」

0x002B08.en: 「Just in case, I'll send an advance party to scout ahead.」

0x002B54.en: 「Yes, better that way. Let's have Irm and the others go.@ Viletta, the SRX team will back them up.」

0x002C52.en: 「I wonder if Radha and the others are running late...」

0x002C8F.en: 「I think they're just picking their course carefully.@ There's a chance of running into the Guests too...」

0x002D03.en: 「Yeah. We've already tangled with them twice@ since coming out to space.」

0x002D6E.en: 「The other possibility is the Gaia Sabers...」

0x002DB4.en: 「Be nice if they were busy biting at the Ruina@ instead...」

0x002E0A.en: 「Unknowns at 11 o'clock, elevation 25, range 4.@ Optical readings estimate... Gaia Sabers machines.@ Five of them.」

0x002F3C.en: 「Alright, we'll draw them away from this sector.@ We'll leave contacting the convoy to the SRX team behind us.」

0x002FC8.en: 「Before that... I'll try sending an <IFF> signal.@ I still have my code from my Beta Saber days.」

0x00305C.en: 「Trying to fake our identity? Besides, hasn't your@ ID code already been wiped from their records@ by now?」

0x0030FB.en: 「Probably, yes.@ So instead of mine, I'll doctor a squad-leader code@ and use that.」

0x003185.en: 「If it doesn't work, we go in.@ Send word to the Hagane too.」

0x003231.en: 「I sent an encrypted signal saying we're under@ radio silence on a covert mission.」

0x003290.en: 「Them buying that so easily is suspicious.」

0x0032C7.en: 「You're right.@ We should act with the possibility of a trap in mind.」

0x003320.en: 「Yeah, whether we should change course or not...」

0x00335D.en: 「We avoided a fight here, but the next one@ will be tougher. I think we should link up with@ the convoy as fast as possible.」

0x0033FC.en: 「Agreed.@ They aren't our only enemy... Let's take the gamble.」

0x00344C.en: 「...We've kept you waiting, haven't we?@ Any sign of the Steel Dragon Squadron's welcome?」

0x0034AC.en: 「Should be any time now...@ though those contacts our radar caught earlier@ have me worried.」

0x003521.en: 「The Gaia Sabers. They didn't even close in,@ just moved off, but...」

0x003589.en: 「We're squawking a refugee-transport ID code.@ They won't move against us carelessly.」

0x0035FA.en: 「They're the type to board and inspect.@ If they didn't do that, there may be@ something behind it...」

0x003690.en: 「If it comes to it, we'll explain.@ Though it may only buy us time.」

0x0036FB.en: 「...I'm sorry@ for dragging you all into this...」

0x00374E.en: 「Don't be. We owe the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x003785.en: 「Mm... Radha, looks like our welcome's arrived.」

0x0037BF.en: 「Visual confirmation of the convoy.@ No other machines detected.」

0x00380C.en: 「Well, well. Looks like we dodged the worst case.」

0x003874.en: 「I'm with you on that.@ Though it's a hunch, not psychic power, mind you.@ Everyone, form up around the transport.」

0x003945.en: 「To actually keep using it in that state...@ You've got some nerve.」

0x0039A1.en: 「But it looks more stable@ than I expected...」

0x0039FA.en: 「Radha,@ the Gaia Sabers are prowling around here.@ We're pulling out right away.」

0x003ABD.en: 「Shortsighted, Ariel. The moment we caught you@ on our scopes, you should have just@ changed course.」

0x003B56.en: 「That would have put the convoy in danger.」

0x003B93.en: 「By letting you run, we learned that the transport@ isn't carrying any refugees.」

0x003C07.en: 「And that its cargo is something vital to you.@ That IFF signal came back to bite you.」

0x003C85.en: 「But thanks to your overthinking, we got to the@ convoy first.」

0x003D02.en: 「And so he has his pretext.@　Anyone siding with the Steel Dragons is guilty too.」

0x003D58.en: 「...Lieutenant Irm, I'll draw Duvan away.@　Use that opening to get the transport out.」

0x003DD5.en: 「No. Odds are he's got a separate unit out there.@　We hold together and wait for the Hagane.@　We'll turn Duvan's own aim against him.」

0x003EA5.en: 「Right. He probably thinks Alfimi's@　aboard the Hagane.」

0x003F79.en: 「All units, leave Ariel to me.@　You can sink the transports. Move out!」

0x0040B2.en: 「...No sign of the Red Ogre.@　Don't tell me he's...」

0x004105.en: 「Alfimi vanished after that and hasn't shown.@　Looks like your gamble missed, Duvan.」

0x004195.en: 「Figures. The bastard had an ambush waiting.」

0x004204.en: 「High-speed object, closing! Twelve o'clock, twenty down!@　Count is one!」

0x00429E.en: 「I need no help from you, Amara...!」

0x0042DB.en: 「I have a mission of my own.」

0x004309.en: 「That's the one from the data@　Lieutenant Ryoto gave us...」

0x004362.en: 「Yes. Code name 'Evil'...@　the machine that destroyed the@　Huckebein series at Orleans.」

0x00447A.en: 「I don't sense any psychic power... but...」

0x0044C4.en: 「Can you hear me, Steel Dragons.@ I am Amara Barton, Omega Saber@ of the Gaia Sabers.」

0x00454E.en: 「So it really was the Gaia Sabers!」

0x00458E.en: 「Omega Saber...@　Does that ring a bell, Ariel?」

0x0045F7.en: 「No surprise a traitor wouldn't know.@　The Omega Sabers' existence was@　kept secret until recently.」

0x00468D.en: 「I stand at the top of all the Sabers,@　and with the High Personal Trooper Galilnagant,@　I serve as Commander Alteur's right hand.」

0x004784.en: 「A Personal Trooper that transcends@　the Personal Trooper itself...」

0x0047E0.en: 「A machine built from Huckebein series data@　and the technology cultivated@　within the Gaia Sabers.」

0x004873.en: 「I see. A hyper Personal Trooper,@　hence a High Personal Trooper.」

0x0048EA.en: 「Why did you destroy the Huckebeins@　and make off with the Black Hole Engine@　and the Tronium Engine?」

0x004989.en: 「I couldn't let the Guests take them.@　The engine cores especially. If I hadn't acted,@　it would've been a close call, no?」

0x004A40.en: 「Amara Barton...@　why did you come straight for me at the Tesla lab?」

0x004AA8.en: 「Because you're a deserter from the Gaia Sabers.@　A traitor.」

0x004B0A.en: （...Best to tell him that much, for now.）

0x004B50.en: （Is that really all it is...?@　Doesn't it tie into my past somehow...?）

0x004BC4.en: 「It's my first time seeing him,@　but it feels like I already know him...」

0x004C33.en: 「I can't say why, but I've got a bad feeling...!」

0x004C73.en: 「So do I... a pressure unlike any psychic force...」

0x004CB6.en: 「This feeling... I think I've felt it before...」

0x004D37.en: 「I get deja vu from the machine,@　but that's just because it resembles the Huckebein.」

0x004DA8.en: 「Either way, that thing is dangerous. I just know it.」

0x004E01.en: （Even Captain Viletta is saying such things...）

0x004E82.en: 「Duvan Org.@　Leave the rest to me and fall back if you wish.」

0x004ED8.en: 「Don't be absurd.@　I'll clean up the Beta Sabers' mess with my own hands.」

0x004F37.en: 「You just cling to the Idealant. Don't overdo it.@　Every life has its limits...@　yours most of all.」

0x005005.en: 「Idle talk. Pay it no mind.@　If you won't withdraw, then stay out of my way.」

0x0050B1.en: 「Now, show me your true nature!@　Just as you did the first time you rode that patchwork!」

0x005144.en: 「Hmph. Can't draw out your power at will?@　Then here!」

0x0051BC.en: 「Hahaha! I'll corner you!@　Fight for real, or you'll die!!」

0x005252.en: 「Galilnagant's going after Ing!@　Anyone nearby, cover him!」

0x0052B4.en: 「Ariel, do Amara's words mean anything to you?」

0x005300.en: 「Silence is an answer too.@　Speak! What do you know!?」

0x005353.en: 「...Even if you knew, nothing would change.」

0x00539C.en: 「So you won't talk!@　Then I'll beat it out of you!」

0x0053EF.en: 「Amara Barton!@　You know it, don't you?@　The truth about the Idealant!」

0x005489.en: 「I'll hunt you down, SRX Team!@　You and the Steel Dragons are no longer of use!」

0x0054F1.en: 「What the hell are you!?@　What is this feeling supposed to be!?」

0x00554D.en: 「Die here, and you won't have to worry about it!」

0x005593.en: 「I sense no psychic force. So why...!?」

0x0055D6.en: 「Heheheh.@　Just be silent and be hunted, all of you!」

0x005663.en: 「Of course. I have the Steel Dragons' data.」

0x0056A3.en: 「It's more than that... I'm sure of it!」

0x0056F9.en: （I... know her. That machine.@　That's how it feels. But why?）

0x00576A.en: （Heheh... if you knew my true identity,@　you'd be shocked indeed.）

0x0057EB.en: （Hmph... I told him not to overdo it.）

0x00582E.en: 「I can't fall until I have Alfimi...!@　I'm withdrawing!」

0x00589F.en: 「Cornering Ing while the Steel Dragons are here@　seems to have no effect.@　I'll have to change my approach.」

0x00592C.en: 「Tch... Cornering Ing while the Steel Dragons@　are here seems to have no effect.@　I'll have to change my approach...!」

0x0059CE.en: 「With Alfimi not aboard the Hagane,@　pushing too hard here is unwise. I'll withdraw as well.」

0x005A45.en: 「No enemy forces remain.@　No sign of reinforcements either.」

0x005AB8.en: 「Good. Keep a full watch. We'll make contact with the transports.」

0x005B14.en: 「The Flickerei Geist...@　To think Alt's parts would be used like this.」

0x005BA7.en: 「It's not for you to apologize.@　Though I don't care for that dubious 'Fau Kern'@　being built into it...」

0x005C61.en: 「Having a piece of Alt exist like this@　makes me happy, as its developer.」

0x005CD2.en: 「Still... the man who set the whole thing in motion@　seems to be standing right there.」

0x005D3A.en: 「...This isn't how I intended things to go.」

0x005D86.en: 「But I feel a certain twist of fate.@　That includes me being on this ship.」

0x005E41.en: 「...Radha, how are things on the moon?」

0x005E81.en: 「A stalemate, I'd say.@　Once the Guests appeared on Earth, the Space Force@　went on alert at the lunar bases and cities...」

0x005F3E.en: 「So we didn't simply lose air superiority,@　but Moon Cradle had heavy enemy forces thrown at it,@　and its defense unit was wiped out, they say.」

0x006013.en: 「Then Moon Cradle has fallen into enemy hands...」

0x00605F.en: 「The Inspectors once seized that place,@　so perhaps the Guests knew how to take it...」

0x0060F5.en: 「Radha... what about Selevis City@　and Mao Industries headquarters?」

0x006157.en: 「They were still safe when we left.」

0x006194.en: 「You left HQ on the president's orders?」

0x0061C8.en: 「Yes. Right after the Guest invasion came to light,@　I was told to gather everything in development@　and ship it to Earth.」

0x006258.en: 「In the <Inspector incident> the new machines were targeted...@　This was a measure drawn from that lesson.」

0x0062EC.en: 「Though I never imagined@　our destination itself would vanish.」

0x006348.en: 「So we changed course for the Colony cluster in the L4 region...@　and on the way there, we managed to make contact@　with the Hagane.」

0x006412.en: 「Did you bring out all the parts for the Exbein?」

0x00645E.en: 「We did... but the string of incidents@　put the work behind schedule.」

0x0064C3.en: 「Still, now we have the machine and the parts.@　The rest is how to finish it efficiently...」

0x00655D.en: 「I'll help too. As a PT developer myself,@　I won't let some High Personal Trooper upstage us.@　Let's get to work.」

0x00663B.en: 「Agreed.@　First, swapping out Ash's engine module.」

0x00668E.en: 「Yeah, we should get to that early, then rebalance@　the upper body and the bypass systems...」

0x00670E.en: 「Looks like they're really fired up now.@　I'm looking forward to the result.」

0x0067B6.en: 「I know. She stayed with the company, right?」

0x006803.en: 「Well, given what happened last time...@　that's just like her.」

0x00688A.en: 「Radha... the supplies you shared were a big help,@　but are you sure you're all right?」

0x0068F5.en: 「Captain Modonell says the Steel Dragons@　once saved him during the Inspector incident.@　This was his way of repaying that debt.」

0x0069AC.en: 「What? He never said a word of that to me...」

0x0069E6.en: 「Sounds like a man of real spirit.@　...Now, Captain, what's the call?@　Straight for the moon, as planned?」

0x006A76.en: 「About that... if the Space Force is fighting the Guests@　on the moon, I think we'd do better@　heading for Heaven's Gate.」

0x006B61.en: 「Yes. It may sound wrong, but the fewer friendly units@　there are in an active operation,@　the easier it is for us to move.」

0x006C00.en: 「If the Space Force is intact, they could turn pursuer too...@　But what about Moon Cradle?@　Odds are it's already fallen.」

0x006CA8.en: 「Without friendly backup, heading there@　alone in a single ship would be dangerous.」

0x006D19.en: 「True... Heaven's Gate is easier to strike.」

0x006D5C.en: 「Leave the moon and colonies to the Space Force.@ We've fought the Melior Esse before, so we should@ head for Heaven's Gate and unravel the Rift.」

0x006E69.en: 「Say, Ing.@　You really don't remember that Amara girl at all?」

0x006EE8.en: 「Last time too, it felt like she was deliberately@　pushing Ing into a corner...」

0x006FAF.en: 「To draw out Ing's power...@　to make him grow, perhaps.」

0x007017.en: 「Psychodrivers tend to unleash their power@　when driven into a crisis, but...」

0x007079.en: 「Deliberately hurting someone to force growth...@　I know that method well.」

0x00710D.en: 「Yeah.@　To forge us into powerful pawns,@　he made himself our enemy...」

0x00717F.en: 「So you think that's Amara's aim too?」

0x0071D5.en: 「If she cast Ing out to make him a future asset@　for the Gaia Sabers, and became his enemy@　to spur that growth...」

0x0072C9.en: 「True...@ Ingram started out as the SRX Team's commander,@ raising Ryusei and the others.」

0x007359.en: （If there's a possibility, it's that@　Ing himself isn't aware of it...）

0x0073B5.en: 「Either way, Amara Barton seems to have@　some connection to my past...」

0x007432.en: 「And the Galilnagant...@　what was that feeling when I saw it?」

0x0074A6.en: 「If four of you felt it, Ryusei included,@ it can't be dismissed as mere coincidence.」

0x007554.en: 「...I have a request for all of you.」

0x007595.en: 「If I fight Amara and lose control@　of my own power...」

0x007600.en: 「If I end up turning on all of you...@　please, stop me.」

0x007668.en: 「Even if it costs you your life?」
